**Comparability:** Both figures come from the same filing and the same reporting entity on a consistent basis (Apple Inc. annual results, as reported in the FY2024 Form 10-K), so the two ratios are directly comparable [DOC-1]. One minor caveat not addressed in the excerpt: Apple's fiscal years are 52/53-week periods, so a week-count difference between FY2023 and FY2024 could slightly affect both the numerator and denominator; the excerpt provides no information on week counts, and the effect on a ratio of two same-period figures would in any case be small.

**Calculation:**

- FY2023: R&D expense $29,915M ÷ revenue $383,285M = **7.80%** [DOC-1]
- FY2024: R&D expense $31,370M ÷ revenue $391,035M = **8.02%** [DOC-1]

**Direction and magnitude:** R&D intensity **increased** by approximately 0.22 percentage points (8.02% − 7.80%). This reflects R&D growing ~4.9% year over year ($29,915M → $31,370M) versus revenue growth of only ~2.0% ($383,285M → $391,035M) [DOC-1].

ANSWER: Increased by approximately 0.22 percentage points (from ~7.80% in FY2023 to ~8.02% in FY2024)
